sections.heading: Looking for beta testers
body: We are looking for theatres that want to get involved early. Together we will shape the interface so it fits your day-to-day work - not the other way around.
In return you get a direct line to the development team, your system informs the design, and you will be among the first to connect to platforms, archives and media.

sections.heading: What's in it for you
body: No more tedious copy and paste into third-party systems.
Automatic data transfer to archives, platforms, display systems and press services.
Full control: you decide who may use which data.
